description: This Java class, PoliciesValidator, implements the Validator interface to validate policy entries by checking for minimal required permissions on policies. It analyzes a collection of PolicyEntry objects to determine if the necessary permissions are granted, focusing on root resource permissions.

classes.name: PoliciesValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates policies based on specified policy entries, focusing on permission grants for root resources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PoliciesValidator with the provided policy entries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation to check if policy entries grant the minimum required permissions.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional reason message if validation fails.

methods.name: hasPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a policy entry grants required permissions on the root resource.

methods.name: hasPermissionRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a policy entry revokes required permissions on the root resource.
